title: Encoder & Resolver Price Pakistan 2026: Incremental Absolute Rotary PNP NPN Push-Pull 1024PPR Hollow Shaft Industry 4.0 Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete 2026 buyer guide for rotary encoders and resolvers in Pakistan: incremental vs absolute selection, single-turn vs multi-turn absolute for gearbox applications, PPR resolution over-specification problem, PNP/NPN/HTL/RS-422 output selection for cable length, hollow shaft retrofit vs solid shaft with coupling, IP67 magnetic vs optical for Karachi humidity and Faisalabad textile dust, resolver for high-temperature Pakistan cement and steel applications, IO-Link and SSI Industry 4.0 interfaces, and PKR 2026 price tables for 5 Pakistani cities.
